items.rationale: Frost fracture of a fitting inside the building is covered under 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9; the like-for-like item is paid at the prior rate.
A connection element renewed with the fractured fitting is covered under 7.1.9, at the prior rate.
Labour on the covered fitting repair is covered under 7.1.7(f); 3 hrs x ~100 EUR.
Consumables are nominally covered under 7.1.7(e), but this line was declined under this wording every time before, as an undertaking's own small material.
One attendance per undertaking is covered under 7.1.11; under this WD-2026 wording it was paid at about 40 EUR.
Leak location equipment is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2, well within the EUR 2,500 cap; prior revealed range was 15-20 EUR.

items.description: Facade damage from internal water escape that froze
items.rationale: Render saturated by escaping water that then froze is escape-of-water damage under 2.4.3, so the optional frost peril is not needed. Priced as a lump-sum removal/making-good item.
Taking off failed material on the affected part is covered under 7.1.7(a), via 2.4.3; rate taken from the removal line in case 32 (~157 EUR per pc).
Re-forming the substrate of the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(c); prior rate ~38 EUR.
An unspecified item on the affected facade, possibly covered as work under 7.1.7, but vague under 9.6; price is a rough guess.
Substrate preparation on the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(c); prior rate ~31 EUR.
The finish system with the coats it requires is covered under 7.1.7(d); prior rate ~59 EUR.
Drying needed before repair of the affected part is covered under 7.1.7(c); prior rate ~254 EUR.
Priming the affected area is covered as part of the finish under 7.1.7; prior rate ~117 EUR.
Labour on the covered facade repair is covered under 7.1.7(f); 5 hrs x ~55 EUR.
An unspecified flat charge is likely administration or processing excluded under 3.6(b) and 7.1.12; it was never indemnified before.
